primaryRootCause.exactRule: Runtime TDI APPROVED is gated on BUY outcomes (hybrid + master legacy), while tdi-sensitivity falsely equates APPROVED with consensusScore >= 55. Hybrid converts all score-qualified setups to HOLD via momentumWeak/techStrongButOthersWeak; master rejects via confidence < 40 and never reaches BUY thresholds.
primaryRootCause.observed: 5067 records score>=55, 0 APPROVED, 3226 HOLD, 3125 master NO_TRADE among score>=55
primaryRootCause.expected: Sensitivity predicts ~5067*0.284≈1430 approvable at threshold semantics — but production has 0 because approval semantics differ
primaryRootCause.difference: Sensitivity measures score pass rate; production measures BUY pass rate under momentum+confidence+expert matrix rules
